programme.desc: Screen idol Derek Yee is the ambitious 'Meteor' master who becomes obsessed with sword supremacy and goes on a selfish rampage of violence and sex.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: A nightclub owner (Peter Chen Ho) has his way with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Also starring Lily Ho, Chin Ping.

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: This hard-hitting drama is based on a real-life investigation on the involvement of both cops as well as crooks in second offences.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager's use of the Boxers to remove the foreign powers from China yields unexpected results. Starring Alexander Fu.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: Martial arts maestro Lo Wei wrote, directed and co-starred in this tale of greed and lust for financial gain that depicts a family brought to its knees.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: Catch this rare gem, a product of Hong Kong-style science fiction, complete with out-of-this-world visual effects.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: After a master passes on his magical weapon to his top student, a jealous rival goes and kidnaps the man's fiance.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: In this award-winning classic, a beauty disguises herself as a boy to attend school yet tend to her lover. Stars Lo Ti, Ling Po.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Starring Ti Lung, this seafaring tale of a daring 'Robin Hood' of the deep is directed by the godfather of kung fu films Chang Cheh, Wu Ma and Pao Hsueh-li.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po and Chin Han return with a Huangmei Opera classic, depicting a loving couple whose marriage is being poisoned by the husband's stepmother.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: In this lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, two cardsharks spar in a battle of wits and fists to become king of the casino.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: This is the first of four related Shaw Brothers film adaptations of the legendary Journey To The West.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: A magic solar baby who's sent to Earth by a benevolent god grows up to have superpowers but loses them during solar eclipses.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: This splendid, award-winning film features Li Li Hua as the Empress Wu Tse-tien, the most powerful woman in China's four thousand year history.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns to find his ruthless brother has taken over the family business and imprisoned their sister. Now, Hu and his sister must fight to get their lives back.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: In this adapation of a Qiong Yao novel, a young woman finds lust, trouble, and, finally, happiness at a picturesque farm.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chang Cheh presents this ultimate depiction of dysfunctional kung fu masters, overcoming their shortcomings to win the day, one corpse at a time.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Be tickled by the slippery efforts of three pickpockets, so adept at their chosen skill that they even manage to fleece three beauties of their underwear!

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: In this twist-filled action film, a country girl is saved by a hero and remains coveted by her jilted lover.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: The Shaw Brothers' directors created this 60's classic depicting a timeless romance between a wealthy man and a songbird.

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: A young man and his sifu earn a living as pseudo-ghost catchers until his sifu is arrested and an honest gal becomes his new companion.

programme.title: Diau Charn

programme.title: The Assassin

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: Based on a famed Chinese opera, this melodramatic film depicts the romance between Zhang Sheng, an impoverished scholar, and Ying Ying, who is from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: A young couple lived happily in a house but the woman becomes haunted after she accidentally kills her husband.

programme.title: Black Magic 2

programme.title: Demon of the Lute

programme.title: The Mermaid

programme.title: Two Con Men

programme.desc: A virtuous lone swordsman who is not without individual weaknesses (Ti Lung) finally decides that it's payback time.

programme.title: The Girl on a Bulldozer
programme.desc: As the girl seeks truth behind the sudden car accident of her father, anger and despair left her only one option.

programme.title: Hitman: Agent Jun
programme.desc: While under the influence of alcohol, an unsuccessful comic book writer draws a comic about his life as a former NIS hitman, and runs into trouble when it gets posted online.

programme.title: The Hot-blooded
programme.desc: 4 friends gave up on Taekwondo and part ways after being asked to lose on purpose in a trial. Years later, they decided to take on a local gang realizing their hometown is threatened.

programme.title: Okay! Madam
programme.desc: A married couple unwittingly become involved in a rescue operation of a hijacked aircraft during their first-ever family trip abroad to Hawaii.

programme.title: Citizen of a Kind
programme.desc: Duk-hee receives a call from a bank offering a loan. After sending money for fees, she realizes that was a scam. She receives another call one day. This time, it's a plea for help...

programme.title: What a Man Wants
programme.desc: Taxi driver Seok-geun, his sister Mi-young, and their spouses face infidelity, desire, and tangled emotions while searching for love, laughter, and meaning in their lives.

programme.title: Highway Family
programme.desc: A grieving mother met a homeless young family taking shelter in highway rest areas when they asks her for money.

programme.title: Pipeline
programme.desc: A team of experts were put together to drill into Korea's oil pipeline and steal petroleum, but the plan takes a turn as the group begin to deceive one another...

programme.title: Cart

programme.title: The Goblin

programme.title: Love 911

programme.title: Ready o/r Knot

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: When the reluctant son of a gangster is summoned home to avenge his father's death, he enlists his father's always-drunk bodyguard to help him out.

programme.title: LEIO

programme.title: Mama's Affair

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: After a security engineer unwittingly becomes involved in a money laundering operation, he must fight against his boss in the cyber world to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: Three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists on dinner together every night, but tensions rises when their girlfriends join the table.

programme.title: Untouchable

programme.title: True Love For Once In My Life

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Framed and forced to leave all he loves, a grocery clerk ultimately grows into one of Shanghai's most powerful mob bosses. Yet, can he leave the past behind?

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career, but Adam is determined to win her back and makes 77 attempts to do so. The situation worsens when a Thai movie idol courts Eva

programme.title: Song of Spring

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: Starring Donnie Yen, Nicholas Tse, an inspector discovers that the team of masked thugs who killed his co-workers are led by a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony

programme.title: Trouble Girl

programme.title: Table for Six 2

programme.title: I Did it My Way
programme.desc: As the secretive dark world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and secret operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: A remake from the Japanese movie Key of Life, Andy Lau, Xiao Yang and Wan Qian stars in this action comedy about the switched identities of an unsuccessful actor & a professional assassin.

programme.title: My Blue Summer
programme.desc: Zhi has been secretly in love with high school classmate Nan from the moment they met. They finally become close friends when they entered the same university, but will Zhi ever confess his feelings?

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: Specializing in overseas security jobs, The Wolf Pack discovers that terrorists are planning to destroy the country's energy source. Lead by Lao Diao, the pack must move out to stop them!

programme.title: I Still Remember
programme.desc: An uplifting sports drama focusing on a property agent who leads an aimless, unfulfilling life & his P.E teacher, as they seek to find purpose in their lives.

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: After years of self-neglect, Le Ying decides to embrace life anew. Meeting a boxing coach sparks her desire for a fresh start. Despite the challenges ahead, she embarks on a transformative journey.

programme.title: Under Current
programme.desc: The death of a charity's CFO and a missing donation force lawyer Ma into an alliance with a police officer. Together, they risk everything to uncover the charity's darkest secrets and seek justice.

programme.title: Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: Negotiator Wai is framed for murder. He takes hostages at the police station and demands talk with a former negotiator. As they engage in a tense battle of wits, their perspectives gradually shift.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: Deceived by a romantic scam and burdened with a massive debt, Lin partners with con artist Ouyang to reclaim her money. Together, they defy the odds and discover an unexpected love in the process.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: In a world without dreams, a monster wanders through a vanishing dreamworld. A woman who can see its hidden visions ventures deep into its dreams to seek the buried truth.

programme.title: Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In
programme.desc: Young Chan Lok Kwun accidentally stumbles into the dangerous Kowloon Walled City, subsequently finding purpose amid chaos and gaining wisdom while becoming one of the City's protectors.

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: When an engaged couple is requested to invite their parents for a CNY client event, the fiance - who is estranged from his mother, fakes a family. However, things spiral out of control.

programme.title: My First Of May
programme.desc: Former squash champion Teng and his wife are devastated by their daughter's muscular dystrophy. Years later, the faint movement of her pinky finger gives them a small but powerful sign of hope.

programme.title: Back Home
programme.desc: Wing, who can see ghosts since young, discovers that the visions that once haunted him have become worse in his home. Caught between the living and dead, Wing must bring the truth to light to be free.

programme.title: The Lychee Road
programme.desc: A single lychee triggers a Tang Dynasty "Mission Impossible"! Junior official Li races 1,000 miles in three days to satisfy a consort's craving - an epic ride of tension, humour and biting satire!

programme.title: The Brotherhood of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his friend Meow flee after Meow's attempt to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, their paths cross when Meow's life is in danger again. Will Chai choose loyalty over duty?

programme.title: MUMU
programme.desc: Mumu connects her deaf father to the outside world, but their peaceful life is disrupted when she must adapt and fit in to the hearing world, while her father is ensnared by a gang to commit crime.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians: Wind Rises in the Desert
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive across the desert to Chang'an, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: L Storm
programme.desc: ICAC officer Luk and Inspector Lau are stuck in their investigation for bribery and money laundering cases. Framed for bribery, Luk risks everything to gather evidence to clear his name.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit
programme.desc: Three devastated parents unite after their children are abducted. Driven by grief and rage, they hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate to bring their children home alive.

programme.title: Victim(s)
programme.desc: After a ruthless Kuala Lumpur student murders his classmate, the victim's mother and the killer's mother uncover hidden truths about their sons and face very different paths of grief and torment.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, this sequel depicts a new inn that has risen from the ashes - one staffed by treasure seekers in disguise.

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon
programme.desc: When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse?

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins
programme.desc: Winner of 8 HKFA awards & featuring an all-star cast, this film depicts an elite team guarding Dr Sun Yat Sen in Hong Kong, as he discusses plans to overthrow the Qing dynasty.

programme.title: Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: Hong Kong's survival is at risk due to a radiation leak. A fire brigade is assigned to stop cesium fallout by entering the radiation zone. Facing this unprecedented disaster, can they save the city?

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, the murder of a white woman in Chinatown ignites public outrage. Two Chinese detectives race against time to uncover the true killer amid mounting tension and danger.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Yam Tai Foon, a wealthy man is unhappy with his son's failed marriage and Kwai's dream of being a comic artist. He pins hopes on his daughter, On, but she returns from France with wild Ruberto.

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: Ming falls into coma and is transported to a fantasy realm where old Master Turtle teaches him ancient boxing skill to defeat an evil boss. Meanwhile, Ming's mother finds a way to save her son.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Caught in an underground fight to pay off debts, talented boxer Jia Yang loses her Olympics dream and quits boxing. A decade later, Coach Li aids her comeback. Can Jia Yang resurrect her boxing dream?

programme.title: CJ7
programme.desc: When a poor laborer picks up a toy for his son from a dumpster, the events that follow teach them about the true nature of family and things money can't buy.

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon

programme.title: Hitman: Agent Jun
programme.desc: While under the influence of alcohol, an unsuccessful comic book writer draws a comic about his life as a former NIS hitman, and runs into trouble when it gets posted online.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Su-young gets entangled in corruption and takes the blame for a reward. After her release, she finds Andy who promised her the reward but faces a bigger force behind him.

programme.title: My Daughter Is a Zombie
programme.desc: Jung-hwan's daughter, Soo-ah, is infected with a zombie virus. He notices that she still seems to understand words, so he draws on his experience with animal training to guide his zombie daughter.

programme.title: The Goblin
programme.desc: After ten years in jail, Doohyun is released and wants nothing more than to live an ordinary life, but when his old partner kidnaps his daughter, the long-hidden Goblin inside him awakes.

programme.title: Noryang: Deadly Sea
programme.desc: Based on the historical Battle of Noryang in 1598. A story of Yi Sun-Shin's last battle during the Japanese invasions of Korea.

programme.title: A Melody to Remember
programme.desc: Amidst the Korean War in 1952, Lt. Han Sang-ryul formed a choir with the orphaned refugee children in Busan, finding solace and purpose through music, despite the hardships of war.

programme.title: Cafe Midnight
programme.desc: Yoon went searching for her groom Taeyoung who didn't show up on the wedding day. She arrives at a strange place called 'Cafe Midnight' by chance and found a younger Taeyoung from the past.

programme.title: Hi-five
programme.desc: Five strangers gain organs and superpowers from a mysterious donor. United by markings, they clash as a team while a cult leader hunts them to steal their powers and achieve immortality.

programme.title: Citizen of a Kind
programme.desc: Duk-hee receives a call from a bank offering a loan. After sending money for fees, she realizes that was a scam. She receives another call one day. This time, it's a plea for help...

programme.title: Ordinary Person
programme.desc: Sung-jin is a police officer involved in a conspiracy after he arrested a suspected murderer by chance. Gyu-nam make use of Sung-jin's weakness, his family, to strike a deal with him.

programme.title: In Our Prime
programme.desc: Genius Mathematician defected from the North tried to hide his past eventually started teaching a student who gave up on Maths the right way to find the answer.

programme.title: 4pm
programme.desc: A couple moved to a new house, dreaming of a peaceful country life. But they face a terrifying reality due to their neighbor, who visits them at the same time every day with just silence...

programme.title: Highway Family
programme.desc: A grieving mother met a homeless young family taking shelter in highway rest areas when they asks her for money.

programme.title: Mama
programme.desc: A story of Dong-sook, a mom with incurable illness and her son has fatal disease, Eun-sook, whose dreams eclipsed by her mom and Seung-chul, a gangster tries to find his mom's first love.

programme.title: Punch-drunk Love
programme.desc: Bok-seo gave up to be a soccer player after an injury. He meets Bok-hee and falls in love with her. Bok-hee feels unsure but she appreciates his sincerity, leading to something special...

programme.title: Hi-five
programme.desc: Five strangers gain organs and superpowers from a mysterious donor. United by markings, they clash as a team while a cult leader hunts them to steal their powers and achieve immortality.

programme.title: Firefighters
programme.desc: Based on the Hongje-dong fire accident in 2001, the movie depicts the harsh conditions that firefighters face every day as if it were their last mission to save lives and survive.

programme.title: Actionhero
programme.desc: A college student dreaming to be an action star discovered an admission fraud. He decided to make an action film of him against the corrupted professor.

programme.title: You Will Die in 6 Hours
programme.desc: Jun-woo tells Jung-yoon that she'll be stabbed to death in 6 hours. She doubts his words but still wants to find out the truth. She later realizes he is related to serial killings...

programme.desc: Think you know Malaysia? Think again. Ezra Zaid will take you on a journey to explore and discover the unexpected sides. Uncover twists behind the historical tales, figures and places you thought you knew.

programme.title: The Toys That Built the World S3 Ep11
programme.desc: From pedal cars to Power Wheels, we're rolling our way through the history of the hottest toys on wheels and the surprising stories behind their creations.

programme.title: The Toys That Built the World S3 Ep12
programme.desc: From Furbys to Pogs, the 1990s were full of unforgettable fad toys! It was a decade where old-school toys like Beanie Babies went head-to-head with high-tech wonders like Tamagotchi.

programme.title: Pionnier 1952
programme.desc: Pionnier 1952 revisits the sacrifices of UN soldiers still listed as missing in action. The film sheds light on the French Battalion's role in the Korean War and the enduring human cost of the war.

programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries S6 Ep04
programme.desc: He was the first Public Enemy No. 1, the legendary outlaw John Dillinger. His life consisted of bank robberies nationwide, but his death remains shrouded in mystery. What really happened to John Dillinger?

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler S1 Ep02

programme.title: Peacekeepers Ep01
programme.desc: In this episode, the cameras are embedded with the infantry battalion as they take on the role of peacekeepers. Arriving in Juba, they first construct their new base within the United Nations' compound.

programme.title: How Disney Built America Ep01
programme.desc: A cartoon studio creates one of the most recognisable characters in the world. Mickey Mouse begins as a pencil sketch, and through a journey of failure, innovation, and guts becomes an American icon.

programme.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid S2 Ep17

programme.title: Pawn Stars S24 Ep623

programme.title: The Food That Built Asia Ep03
programme.desc: Ironically, many components of Malaysia's national dish, Nasi Lemak are NOT even from Malaysia! Let's take a look at how this old rice dish came to be and how its evolution tells the history of the nation.

programme.title: The Food That Built Asia Ep04

programme.title: History's Greatest Escapes With Morgan Freeman S2 Ep09
programme.desc: Quawntay Adams gets caught up in a big marijuana bust and is sentenced to a long prison term. When he finds out he is going to be a father, he determines to break out of his maximum-security cell.

programme.title: The Food That Built the World S5 Ep11
